Management Plan
- management_plan_main_or_not_recorded: 
  - Symptomatic management for acute diarrhoea: maintain oral fluids; consider oral rehydration solution (Dioralyte) to replace lost salts
  - Dietary advice: soft/bland diet (crackers, toast, jam, boiled/mashed vegetables); avoid meat/fish/eggs/dairy while symptomatic; yogurt suggested for probiotic benefit
  - Advice to seek further care / provide stool sample if: blood in stool, diarrhoea persists >1 week, or symptoms worsen
  - Warning signs: if stool frequency increases to ~6–8 times/day or more (risk of dehydration) — seek urgent care/hospital
  - No medications prescribed during consult
